<style id="oh-deal-desk">
/*!
 * Dealality Old Home — Problem Deal Desk (Phase A polish-v2 static)
 * Scope: #about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk | .dealality-problem-desk
 * No Phase B animation / no autoplay motion.
 */

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk,
.dealality-problem-desk {
  --dpd-bg: #070b1a;
  --dpd-surface: rgba(14, 22, 48, 0.94);
  --dpd-surface-2: rgba(8, 14, 32, 0.98);
  --dpd-border: rgba(155, 138, 251, 0.2);
  --dpd-border-soft: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
  --dpd-text: #ffffff;
  --dpd-muted: rgba(183, 196, 255, 0.72);
  --dpd-muted-2: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.58);
  --dpd-purple: #9b8afb;
  --dpd-purple-deep: #5b21b6;
  --dpd-blue: #60a5fa;
  --dpd-teal: #2dd4bf;
  --dpd-gold: #d4a574;
  --dpd-radius: 16px;
  --dpd-shadow: 0 22px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1180px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  color: var(--dpd-text);
  font-family: "DM Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk *,
.dealality-problem-desk * { box-sizing: border-box; }

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-sr-only,
#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-zone-label,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-sr-only,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-zone-label {
  position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-desk,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-desk {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 1.2rem 1.15rem 1.15rem;
  border-radius: 22px;
  border: 1px solid var(--dpd-border);
  background:

    radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 45% at 92% 88%, rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.08), transparent 52%),
    linear-gradient(165deg, var(--dpd-surface), var(--dpd-surface-2));
  box-shadow: var(--dpd-shadow), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  overflow: visible;
}

#about[data-oh-problem="deal-desk"] .dealality-problem-desk .dpd-flow-lines,
.dealality-problem-desk .dpd-flow-lines {

  height: auto;

  z-index: 0;
  opacity: 0.9;
